# HK MINIJUNGLE

> HK MiniJungle Technology International Limited is a Hong Kong company developing CANVIVA living plant systems for commercial interiors. 讓自然成為空間的一部分。

## About

HK MINIJUNGLE brings living plants, spatial design, material systems and ongoing-care planning into workplaces, property, hospitality and premium commercial interiors. The company is based in Hong Kong and works across Nature + Art + Technology.

## CANVIVA products

### CANVIVA SIGNATURE — 生命畫境・定制

A custom living plant art system for hotels, clubhouses, corporate headquarters and premium commercial spaces.

### CANVIVA WALL — 生命畫境・綠牆

An integrated vertical greenery system that creates a continuous planted interface for workplaces, commercial property and public interiors.

### CANVIVA PANEL — 生命畫境・植景屏

A self-contained living plant panel integrating planting, frame, growing system and lighting for flexible placement indoors.

Final dimensions, finishes, installation interfaces, lead time, maintenance scope and commercial terms are confirmed for each project. Missing approved materials are visibly labelled on the website.

## Capabilities

- Commercial-space needs and site assessment
- CANVIVA system and planting proposals
- Installation-scope and service-access planning
- Ongoing-care responsibilities and project records
- ESG evidence support within an agreed project scope

## 中文簡介

HK MiniJungle Technology International Limited 是一家香港公司，專注為辦公、物業、酒店會所與高品質商業室內空間開發 CANVIVA 生命植物系統。現行正式產品分類為 CANVIVA SIGNATURE（生命畫境・定制）、CANVIVA WALL（生命畫境・綠牆）與 CANVIVA PANEL（生命畫境・植景屏）。香港是目前已確認的營運基地；香港以外的交付範圍按項目另行確認。
